subject: Request: employee vetting & onboarding artifact snapshot for compliance review
messages:
From: Julian Reyes <julian.reyes@brightlinehealth.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: security@brightlinehealth.com
Date: 2028-05-09T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: employee vetting materials for SOC 2 / SIG review

Hi Rishi,

As part of our SIG assessment ahead of the procurement review, we need a concise bundle showing how Redwood handles prehire vetting, ongoing training, and offboarding. Specifically we're looking for:

- High-level summary of background check coverage and vendor(s) used (types of checks, scope, frequency).
- A redacted sample roster (new hires in last 12 months) showing hire date, role, background-check completed flag, and a non-identifiable personnel id.
- LMS/training completion evidence for security awareness + privacy (screenshots or export) and quarterly completion rates for the last 4 quarters.
- Deprovisioning runbook / timeline (how quickly access is revoked after termination).
- Chain-of-custody for personnel records and how PII is redacted for shared artifacts.

Can you confirm whether you can provide redacted samples and a short narrative tying each item to SIG/CAIQ questions? We're hoping to receive the bundle within 7 business days if possible. If anything is sensitive, please let me know what we can accept as alternative evidence (e.g., policy excerpts + redacted logs).

Thanks,

Julian Reyes
Director, Security Engineering
Brightline Health
security@brightlinehealth.com

Thanks for the detailed ask, Julian — we can provide a bundled package with redacted samples and a short mapping doc that points to SIG/CAIQ sections. A few clarifying points so we deliver exactly what you need: 

1) Redaction level: do you need DOB suppressed fully, or is year-of-birth acceptable? We typically replace PII with an internal hashed ID for sample exports.
2) Background checks: are you looking for vendor evidence (contract + sample report) or just a summary of checks performed?
3) For LMS exports, do you prefer CSV exports or PDF screenshots showing completions?

I've looped in Monica (HR ops) and Lauren (Compliance) to prepare the artifacts. Monica — can you pull a redacted onboarding roster and the Q1 training export? If ScreenCheck (verifications@screencheck.io) needs to provide a sample report, please coordinate and request a redacted copy.

We aim to have a deliverable set in 3 business days (EOD 2028-05-12) unless Julian asks for further granularity. I'll plan to deliver a password-protected archive and a short two-page mapping to SIG/CAIQ.

Attachment: requested_manifest.csv (internal stub listing files we'll include).
